name: 2693-multiturn-qwen25-14b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, bf16, ungated, ~29.5 GB of weights, 28 GB in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, and nothing in front of the engine.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), load carried by `rate`, seeded at 5.0 req/s; 720 s per run with a 300 s absolute warmup, so 420 s is measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over /v1/chat/completions, five turns per conversation, 512 fresh prompt tokens in and 64 out per turn with `ignore_eos: true` at temperature 0.0. A conversation's prompt therefore grows 512 -> 1088 -> 1664 -> 2240 -> 2816 tokens, and between turns it pauses: `delay` 30 s, stdev 12, clipped to [8, 70]. Conversations are independent draws with no shared text between them.
purpose: A five-turn conversational assistant on a 14B model, serving about five short chat requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes the file line by
# line and skips indented ones, so a nested block would be dropped and the engine would start
# without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# Capped explicitly rather than left to `mem-fraction-static`, so the pool is the same size on
# every run instead of whatever the memory profiler happens to leave over on the day.
max-total-tokens: 131072

# The longest prompt this workload presents is under 3.5k tokens; the checkpoint's own 32768
# would size several buffers for a context that is never reached.
context-length: 8192

random-seed: 42
